-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- Phase 1 Foundation Repair: Database Migration
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

-- 1. Add new columns to users table
ALTER TABLE `users` ADD COLUMN `quotaJson` json DEFAULT NULL;
ALTER TABLE `users` ADD COLUMN `onboardingDone` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false;

-- 2. Add new columns to api_usage_logs table
ALTER TABLE `api_usage_logs` ADD COLUMN `model` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL;
ALTER TABLE `api_usage_logs` ADD COLUMN `inputTokens` int DEFAULT NULL;
ALTER TABLE `api_usage_logs` ADD COLUMN `outputTokens` int DEFAULT NULL;
ALTER TABLE `api_usage_logs` ADD COLUMN `modalityParams` json DEFAULT NULL;
ALTER TABLE `api_usage_logs` ADD COLUMN `costCredits` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 1;
ALTER TABLE `api_usage_logs` ADD COLUMN `durationMs` int DEFAULT NULL;
ALTER TABLE `api_usage_logs` ADD COLUMN `success` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true;

-- 3. Add new columns to generation_requests table
ALTER TABLE `generation_requests` ADD COLUMN `compiledPrompt` text DEFAULT NULL;
ALTER TABLE `generation_requests` ADD COLUMN `modalityParams` json DEFAULT NULL;
ALTER TABLE `generation_requests` ADD COLUMN `costCredits` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 1;
ALTER TABLE `generation_requests` ADD COLUMN `durationMs` int DEFAULT NULL;

-- 4. Create consistency_vault table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `consistency_vault` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(256) NOT NULL,
  `itemType` enum('character','scene') NOT NULL,
  `imageUrl` text NOT NULL,
  `fileKey` text,
  `tags` json,
  `metadata` json,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- 5. Create subscription_plans table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `subscription_plans` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `name` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `tier` enum('free','starter','pro','enterprise') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'free',
  `priceMonthly` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `quotaAllocation` json NOT NULL,
  `features` json,
  `isActive` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- 6. Create ai_director_preferences table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `ai_director_preferences` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `personality` enum('calm','creative','technical') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'creative',
  `preferredFormat` enum('co-star','sslcm','selcm','free') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'co-star',
  `customSystemPrompt` text,
  `preferencesJson` json,
  `onboardingSteps` json,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- 7. Create generation_history table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `generation_history` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `requestId` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `modality` enum('image','video','audio','voice') NOT NULL,
  `prompt` text,
  `compiledPrompt` text,
  `parameterSnapshot` json,
  `resultUrl` text,
  `thumbnailUrl` text,
  `userRating` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `isBookmarked` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  `costCredits` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `durationMs` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- 8. Create digital_assets table (replacing old digital_asset_library)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `digital_assets` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(256) NOT NULL,
  `assetType` enum('image','video','audio','voice','document') NOT NULL,
  `fileUrl` text,
  `fileKey` text,
  `mimeType` varchar(128),
  `fileSizeBytes` int,
  `visibility` enum('private','team_shared') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'private',
  `tags` json,
  `sourceRequestId` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- 9. Create project_notes table (replacing old project_notes_calendar)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `project_notes` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(256) NOT NULL,
  `content` text,
  `scriptJson` json,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- 10. Create feedbacks table (replacing old user_feedback_reports)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `feedbacks` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `category` enum('bug','feature','general','praise') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'general',
  `content` text NOT NULL,
  `status` enum('open','in_progress','resolved') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open',
  `adminReply` text,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- 11. Seed default subscription plans
INSERT INTO `subscription_plans` (`name`, `tier`, `priceMonthly`, `quotaAllocation`, `features`) VALUES
('免費方案', 'free', 0, '{"image": 20, "video": 5, "audio": 10, "voice": 10}', '{"priorityQueue": false, "customModels": false, "consistencyVault": true}'),
('入門方案', 'starter', 990, '{"image": 100, "video": 30, "audio": 50, "voice": 50}', '{"priorityQueue": false, "customModels": true, "consistencyVault": true}'),
('專業方案', 'pro', 2990, '{"image": 500, "video": 150, "audio": 300, "voice": 300}', '{"priorityQueue": true, "customModels": true, "consistencyVault": true}'),
('旗艦方案', 'enterprise', 9990, '{"image": 9999, "video": 999, "audio": 9999, "voice": 9999}', '{"priorityQueue": true, "customModels": true, "consistencyVault": true}');
